text.en:
Land Revenue Collection Act
(Chapter 155)
Appointment of Collectors of Land Revenue
N 1
G.N. No. S 477/1990
REVISED EDITION 1990
(25th March 1992)
The following persons have been appointed to be Collectors of Land Revenue:
(a)the officer performing the duties of Commissioner of Lands to be the Collector of Land Revenue; and
[447/46 wef 1.4.46]
(b)the Chief Surveyor to be a Collector of Land Revenue.
[2494/73 wef 17.8.73]
